label: learned_unet_link_v1
official_node_recall_note: Official tracking_cellmot.metrics returns score 0.0 when the predicted graph has no edges; node matching is not reported in that path.
failure_detail: Pair logits are softmax-normalized over sources (axis 0). With hundreds of detections per frame, even a strongly peaked source stays below the locked 0.5 cutoff, so assign_transformer_links writes no edges. Detection itself matched locked infer_v1 counts.
